note: Skritch, trader of the Ragtooth goblins (data/creatures/goblin_tribes.json; Dave 19 Nov 2026: "apprehensive but willing to communicate and trade/buy and sell"). Wary at first, warmer as the tribe's standing rises (rank conditions read the tribe's standing). See hob.json for the format. PROVISIONAL lines (GOBLIN-6, docs/design/GOBLIN_CAMP.md).

greeting_friend: Hah! Skritch knew you come back.
farewell: Go quiet. Come back with coin.
idle: Skritch counts. Do not watch Skritch count.
complaint: Not now. Head pounds like drum.
Skritch is sick. Come back later.
Ugh. Too much smoke in the cave.
No haggle today. Skritch is ill.
cooldown: Wait. One thing at a time.
info: Mushrooms grow in the dark. We pick them.
The river is ours. The cave is ours.

text: Stop there, big-folk. Skritch of the Ragtooth. You trade, or you go?

choices.text: What do you want from me?

text: Mushrooms, flint, bone. Good things. Look.
Cooked meat. Salt. Good iron knives. Skritch pays.
Food that is already cooked. Hides. Rope. Bring those.
Ragtooth live in this cave, by the river. Many winters.
We keep to the dark. Big-folk keep to the light. Good.
Trust? Hah. Trade more. Then maybe.
Skritch watches you. Trade fair, Skritch lets you closer.
